description: Define and validate a manifest schema declaring domains, allowed_dependencies, shared substrate locations, domain glossaries, signal weights, confidence thresholds, and transitional declarations as the trust anchor for intended architecture.

requirements.description: Cartographer must define and validate a manifest schema (AC-MANIFEST-SCHEMA) that serves as the authoritative trust anchor for intended architecture. The manifest must declare: domains and their ownership boundaries; allowed_dependencies between domains (AC-MANIFEST-BOUNDARIES); shared substrate locations; domain glossaries (AC-MANIFEST-GLOSSARY); signal weights and confidence thresholds (AC-MANIFEST-OVERLAY); and transitional declarations. The parser must reject invalid manifests with structured errors. Weights and thresholds declared in the manifest override built-in defaults. Full schema reference documentation must be published under docs/reference (AC-MANIFEST-DOCS).
requirements.title: API Manifest Contract — Schema, Validation, and Trust Anchor

validation.notes: AC-MANIFEST-SCHEMA: Valid manifest parses without errors and produces a fully populated manifest model
AC-MANIFEST-SCHEMA: Missing required fields (e.g., domains) produce structured validation errors with field path and message
AC-MANIFEST-SCHEMA: Unknown top-level keys produce a warning, not a hard failure, unless strict mode is enabled
AC-MANIFEST-BOUNDARIES: allowed_dependencies declared as A→B do not generate a drift conflict when A imports B
AC-MANIFEST-BOUNDARIES: A dependency A→C not declared in allowed_dependencies produces a cross-domain violation conflict
AC-MANIFEST-OVERLAY: Signal weight override in manifest is applied and replaces built-in default weight in aggregator
AC-MANIFEST-OVERLAY: Confidence threshold override is respected by severity classification logic
AC-MANIFEST-GLOSSARY: Domain glossary terms are parsed into a term→domain map accessible to the symbol-glossary signal
Round-trip: parse → validate → serialize → re-parse manifest produces identical manifest model
Manifest with intentional boundary violations loads successfully and produces the expected number of drift conflicts when compared against a fixture graph
docs/reference/manifest-schema.md exists and its field descriptions match the parser's validation rules (smoke test)
A platform engineer can author a manifest from the docs/reference schema alone and have it accepted on first validation
Manifest schema version is declared and validated so stale manifests from prior versions are detected and flagged

title: API Manifest Contract
